integrity: The proof reconstructs the normalization and conductor, distinguishes the separable conductor map from the inseparable repeated-root incidence, and includes exact symbolic and finite-field checks. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is over an algebraically closed field of characteristic two; the finite-field count is of projective coefficient tuples. Known invariant and Segre projection facts are not asserted as new. Historical priority, including an inaccessible later specialist full text, remains a residual risk.
title: Wild conductor geometry of the binary-quartic discriminant in characteristic two
